Acceptance uses exact current target/dependency preimages and preserves every unrelated current object, without requiring the historical global registry hash.

source_crosschecks.finding: The selected goods/materials sense differs from the list sense; recording is not a lexical requirement.
The document passes from buyer to seller and describes the purchase.
The shortfall is relative to recorded expected stock; loss, damage and errors are possibilities, not a finding of theft.
A restocking charge is attached to a return and distinguished from shipping. Configurability grants no legal permission.
Batch/lot, serial and expiration information have distinct roles; a batch identifier is not the physical production group.
Official UK alternate confirms the safety-versus-quality date-label distinction. Only label meanings are used, with no consumption or handling instruction.

independent_review.retrieval_limits: The original GOV.UK date subpage failed during this review; an official alternate supplied the narrow semantic crosscheck. The original 49 consultations remain unchanged: 48 selected-page records and one explicitly index-only USDA passage. No new production source status is verified.
remaining: Separate language metadata acceptance and all applicable inventory, purchasing, legal and food-safety reviews remain pending.

All 200 modules remain draft. No image, audio, morphology or release approval follows from this editorial review.

shared_expression_dependencies.rationale: Retain. Remaining supply is an available quantity and reorder point is a planning trigger. Stock inside stock availability is incidental to that compound, not a new stock focus. The request precedes seeking ingredients and does not prescribe a quantity.

Repair. Coordinates the regional supply naturally selects the providing/distribution process, while the focus is the available-quantity noun. Checking the supply of goods available in the region makes that quantity sense explicit and preserves wholesaler, retailer, distributor and supply focuses.

Retain. The physical stock count reveals a mismatch between goods held and the quantity recorded. Inventory and stock both name goods, with recorded marking the comparison basis; the sentence requests review rather than an automatic adjustment.

Retain. Delivery note and packing list have their respective document roles; inventory/stock mean goods and reaching a reorder point refers to their quantity. Reporting and checking do not authorize a purchase or imply document equivalence.

Retain. Stock item identifies one item type; inventory report is a record while inventory held explicitly means goods. The contrast supports the selected goods sense without conflating it with a list.

Retain. Stock discrepancy is the quantity mismatch and inventory adjustment the requested record change. The words inventory and stock inside those compounds are incidental and do not receive extra focus routes.

Retain. Faulty item is a product with a functional defect subject to review. Perpetual inventory names a separate recordkeeping concept and stock transactions is incidental; neither is used to score the selected inventory noun here.

Retain. Inventory appears only inside the separately focused inventory freeze compound. Asking whether a restriction and recount approval exist does not change the selected inventory goods definition or create an additional focus.

Retain. The count concerns physical goods in inventory, stock level is the recorded quantity, and reorder point is a planning threshold. Reviewing that threshold does not authorize procurement or establish a cause for the difference.

Retain. Stock rotation is a handling sequence; the date labels have different roles and the sentence asks for correct local guidance. The selected safety-related use-by sense is retained; it does not state that every country uses the label identically.

Retain. Supplier return, internal stock transfer and quarantine stock describe different arrangements. Both movements remain pending while the hold is reviewed; no release, return or disposal is approved.

Retain. The goods movement is a stock transfer between recorded source and destination. In-transit stock is a separate focused compound; traceability-record wording is not promoted to domain-approved procedure by this lexical review.

Retain. Available stock, allocated stock, stock reservation and stock availability are separate local-system concepts. Stock is only an incidental component here, and asking for definitions prevents unqualified promises of availability.

Retain. Stock rotation describes handling order, distinct from the blind quantity count. Stock inside that compound is not a separate focus; the sentence records concerns without specifying a rotation method.

Retain. Stock occurs within three separately selected planning compounds. The sentence explicitly depends on an agreed method and gives no universal quantity, so it requires no change to the generic goods sense.

shared_use_decisions.rationale: Retain. Inspection is a later check against the relevant service requirements; clarifying standards first does not approve compliance or require an official regulatory visit.
shared_use_decisions.scope: Selected shared lexical uses only; no other-course domain, morphology, media or release approval.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: supply
original_consultation_records.finding: The available-amount sense differs from the act of providing goods. A supply can be adequate, limited or exhausted; coordinating provision does not clearly select an available quantity.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: inventory
original_consultation_records.finding: Inventory can name a list, the goods themselves, or accounting stock including materials and work in progress. The selected goods sense must not be replaced by the list sense in sentences.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: stock
original_consultation_records.finding: Stock names goods available for sale, with in stock, out of stock and stock checks as ordinary combinations. Financial shares, liquid food and ancestry are separate senses.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: shipment
original_consultation_records.finding: A shipment can be a load of transported goods, distinct from the act of shipping. Incoming selects the direction toward the receiving location.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: purchase order
original_consultation_records.finding: A purchase order goes from the buying party to the selling party and describes the purchase. This direction distinguishes it from an internal purchasing request.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: backorder
original_consultation_records.section: noun definition and on back order pattern
original_consultation_records.finding: The noun describes an order for a currently unavailable product. The source uses the open spelling back order; this consultation does not require a spelling migration of the existing closed form.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: lead time
original_consultation_records.finding: Lead time can span an order to delivery or the start to completion of production. The measured start and end events depend on the process.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: stocktaking
original_consultation_records.finding: The retail sense is checking and listing goods in a business. It is distinct from figurative reflection; the cycle-count source supplies the physical counting distinction.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: batch
original_consultation_records.finding: A batch is a group handled together; the production sense is an amount made at one time. The group itself differs from the code used to identify it.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: serial number
original_consultation_records.finding: A serial number identifies a particular product unit. This contrasts with a batch identifier shared across a production group.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: unit
original_consultation_records.section: noun business sense 2; separate measurement sense
original_consultation_records.finding: The business sense is one product item. A measurement unit is a different sense and an incidental occurrence cannot establish a stock-item focus route.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: consignment
original_consultation_records.finding: The selected noun is a group of goods sent or delivered somewhere. It does not require one vehicle, or mean a consignment-sales ownership agreement.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: replenishment
original_consultation_records.finding: The noun names restoring a supply by replacing what has been used. It is a process, not an order document or a quantity by itself.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: expiration date
original_consultation_records.finding: The phrase covers a stated end of document validity or intended product use; expiration date is labeled North American and expiry date British. It is broader than food safety alone.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: inspection
original_consultation_records.finding: Inspection can mean close examination to check condition, distinct from an official regulatory visit. Looking at an object does not itself certify its safety or compliance.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: packaging
original_consultation_records.section: noun material sense and original packaging combination
original_consultation_records.finding: Packaging names protective or wrapping materials; original packaging is an attested combination. The materials differ from the process of packaging.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: replacement
original_consultation_records.section: noun sense 2 and replacement product combination
original_consultation_records.finding: The countable sense names a thing supplied in place of another. It does not necessarily imply a new item, identical model, refund entitlement or improved quality.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: unwanted
original_consultation_records.finding: Unwanted means not wanted. An unwanted product need not be damaged, unopened or defective.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: faulty
original_consultation_records.finding: Faulty covers things not functioning or made correctly. The project retains its selected functional-defect sense rather than the separate reasoning sense.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: unopened
original_consultation_records.finding: Unopened means not opened yet. A closed or resealed package is not proof of that history.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: code
original_consultation_records.finding: A code can use letters, numbers or symbols to represent information. A product reference is not necessarily a barcode, secret password or individual serial number.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: size
original_consultation_records.finding: Size names standard product measurements; wrong size is an explicit combination. This supports the selected unsuitable-fit or mismatched-dimension phrase.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: wrong
original_consultation_records.finding: Wrong can mean unsuitable or different from what is needed, not only factually false or morally bad.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: damage
original_consultation_records.section: verb physical-harm sense and damaged participle
original_consultation_records.finding: Damage includes harm to an object. Damaged packaging describes harmed protective material and does not prove damage to the enclosed product.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Adjusting inventory quantities
original_consultation_records.section: Introduction, setting new inventory levels, unavailable inventory
original_consultation_records.finding: The provider records quantity adjustments and their history, distinguishes physical counts from record changes, and separately tracks goods that are held but unavailable.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Provider-specific inventory states and controls; no workflow, authorization, accounting policy or automatic adjustment is imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Microsoft: Inventory adjustment wizard
original_consultation_records.finding: The documented system can adjust inventory cost and value as well as other inventory information. This supports the existing quantity-or-value breadth of inventory adjustment.
original_consultation_records.limitation: A Russian software localization example only; no accounting method, posting instruction, tax treatment or localization rule becomes lesson content.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Cycle Counting
original_consultation_records.section: What is cycle counting?; physical counting versus cycle counting
original_consultation_records.finding: Cycle counting repeatedly checks selected product groups; a physical count checks actual goods and can expose differences from recorded quantities.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Terminology only. No count frequency, sample size, statistical method or permission to change records is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Built-in inventory management
original_consultation_records.section: Stay on top of inventory movements with transfers
original_consultation_records.finding: A transfer moves stock between identified origin and destination locations. The provider distinguishes in-transit goods from receipt at the destination.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Provider example only; no transfer approval or instructions to accept goods are imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Collins English Dictionary: delivery note
original_consultation_records.finding: A delivery note is a document accompanying delivered goods. The automated illustrative quotations are not relied on.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Dictionary meaning only; no proof-of-receipt, payment or legal acceptance inference.

original_consultation_records.title: DHL Malaysia: Shipment records and document retention
original_consultation_records.section: Difference between a consignment note and a delivery note, checklist passage
original_consultation_records.finding: The delivery-note passage describes a document between sender and receiver that can list details of the ordered goods.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Only the checklist description is used. The page also reports invoice terminology; that conflation is not adopted. No retention period or contractual effect is imported.

original_consultation_records.title: International Trade Administration: Packing List
original_consultation_records.finding: A packing list itemizes package contents and can describe quantities, weights and package measurements.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Export-document example only; no required format, customs declaration, attachment practice or legal compliance claim is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Oracle Inventory Help: Reorder Point Planning
original_consultation_records.finding: The planning system uses a stock threshold to suggest a replenishment order, with lead time and demand as inputs.
original_consultation_records.limitation: A software planning example only. No formula, threshold, purchase authority or economic recommendation is taught.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Overstocking, causes and prevention
original_consultation_records.finding: Excess inventory remains when holdings exceed selling needs. Overstock is not simply any goods stored behind the sales floor.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Meaning only; no forecast, purchasing or disposal recommendation is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: What is dead stock?
original_consultation_records.section: What is dead stock?; alternate resale meaning
original_consultation_records.finding: Retail dead stock has stayed unsold beyond its expected period and may have little ordinary demand. Sneaker-resale usage can instead mean unworn original-condition goods.
original_consultation_records.limitation: The selected retail inventory sense is retained. No fixed age threshold, guaranteed worthlessness or disposal action is inferred.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Types of shrinkage in retail
original_consultation_records.finding: Loss, damage and recording errors can leave less usable inventory than expected in the records. A routine sale or authorized record edit alone is not shrinkage.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Selected meaning only. Theft is one possible cause, not an accusation or explanation for an individual discrepancy; no loss-prevention procedures or statistics are imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Stock Rotation
original_consultation_records.section: Stock rotation definition and seasonal distinction
original_consultation_records.finding: Stock rotation prioritizes selected goods for sale; arrival order is one method, while seasonal circumstances can also affect the sequence.
original_consultation_records.limitation: No universal rotation method or food-safety clearance is inferred.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: First-in, first-out stock rotation
original_consultation_records.section: Definition of the first-in, first-out stock rotation method
original_consultation_records.finding: The stock-handling method prioritizes earlier received stock for sale or use. The article also discusses a distinct accounting application.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Only physical stock-handling meaning is used. No valuation method, mandatory industry rule, expiry precedence or safety outcome is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: GOV.UK: Best before and use-by dates
original_consultation_records.section: Date distinction; use-by dates; best before dates
original_consultation_records.finding: In the UK guidance, use-by labels concern safety and best-before labels concern quality. Both depend on the relevant storage conditions.
original_consultation_records.limitation: UK labeling sense only. No consumption decision, storage temperature, cooking/freezing extension or statutory advice is added to this vocabulary lesson.

original_consultation_records.title: USDA FSIS: Food Product Dating
original_consultation_records.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
original_consultation_records.section: Indexed passage on sell-by labeling and inventory management
original_consultation_records.finding: The indexed official passage describes sell-by as guidance for how long a store displays a product. This supports the retail-display definition without a universal food-safety rule.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Only the search-index passage was available; direct page retrieval failed. No current legal requirement or consumption guidance is asserted.

original_consultation_records.title: GS1 US: What is a GS1-128 barcode?
original_consultation_records.finding: Batch/lot information, serial number and expiration date are distinct product data attributes. Together with the batch definition, this supports distinguishing group identifiers from unit identifiers.
original_consultation_records.limitation: No barcode image, code construction, global uniqueness claim for a bare lot code, or compliance procedure is imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Using SKUs to manage inventory
original_consultation_records.finding: The source expands SKU as stock keeping unit and uses it for internal product or variant codes. SKUs and barcodes have different functions.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Provider-specific conventions do not establish a global identifier format, required length or one-code-per-unit rule.

original_consultation_records.title: Oracle: Manage the Packaging Hierarchy
original_consultation_records.section: Hierarchy example and Case/Base Unit descriptions
original_consultation_records.finding: A shipping case contains a specified configuration of smaller product units or packs. Counting must identify the relevant packaging level.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Software terminology example only; no universal units-per-case value or packaging standard is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Microsoft: Create a purchase return order
original_consultation_records.finding: A purchase return sends goods back to the vendor. It is distinct from an internal transfer between the buyer's stock locations.
original_consultation_records.limitation: No approval, invoice reversal, return entitlement or execution instructions are imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Return merchandise authorization
original_consultation_records.section: Definition and What is an RMA number?
original_consultation_records.finding: A return process can require approval and assign a reference number to an approved return. The reference helps identify the return; it does not by itself guarantee a particular remedy.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Provider explanation only. No universal RMA requirement, return period, packaging condition or override of consumer rights is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Creating returns and exchanges
original_consultation_records.section: Introduction; return reasons and return-shipping options
original_consultation_records.finding: The provider distinguishes return reasons, shipping labels, exchange items and financial outcomes. Clothing reasons can include sizes that are too large or too small.
original_consultation_records.limitation: No merchant policy, required customer explanation, refund entitlement, fee rate or instruction to create a return is adopted.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Store credit
original_consultation_records.finding: Store credit gives a customer value to apply to purchases with the issuing store and can be tracked as a balance. It is not necessarily a credit-card loan or a cash refund.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Provider-specific account, channel, expiry and redemption restrictions are not generalized.

original_consultation_records.title: Shopify: Setting up return and cancellation rules
original_consultation_records.finding: The provider treats a restocking fee as a charge attached to a return, separately from return shipping. It need not be described as proof that the goods will be resold.
original_consultation_records.limitation: A configurable provider charge is not legal permission to impose it. No fee percentage or refund deduction procedure is taught.

original_consultation_records.title: GOV.UK: Accepting returns and giving refunds
original_consultation_records.section: Faulty goods, unwanted goods and distance-sales distinctions
original_consultation_records.finding: The guidance distinguishes faulty products from change-of-mind returns and contains rights that depend on the circumstances. Packaging can be evidence of purchase rather than a universal condition for a remedy.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Jurisdictional boundary check only. No deadlines, refund guarantees, original-packaging requirement or merchant discretion overriding legal rights is imported.

original_consultation_records.title: Microsoft: Quarantine orders
original_consultation_records.finding: The software uses quarantine to separate and block inventory while a quality concern is considered. Held goods are not automatically cleared, discarded or returned.
original_consultation_records.limitation: Software example only; no safety protocol, release criteria, physical segregation standard or authorization is taught.
